name: Interruption-safe resume
userOutcome: If the app is backgrounded or terminated mid-round, the user can resume at the exact bead count without losing place.
productionDataSource: Application Support active-session.json via ActiveSessionStore; reconstructed with JapaEngine(target:count:).
errorBehavior: Missing or corrupt active session yields no resume card (safe empty). Latest write wins. Zero-count or completed snapshots must not present false progress.
accessibilityRequirements: Resume affordance is labeled and discoverable via VoiceOver
prohibitedBehavior: Do not clear active session on ordinary backgrounding
acceptanceTests: PersistenceTests — active save/flush/load across store instances
